description: Telangana focuses on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration from Primary Level and Enhancing Educational Standards for Better Learning Outcomes. State Minister and Officials discussed AI Implementation in Recent Review Meeting and it was said that there are Potential Benefits of AI in Government Schools.
body_lead: AI in the Classroom! Telangana Education Department Focuses on Artificial Intelligence in Schools Transforming Education with AI Artificial Intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing various industries worldwide, and now, Telangana’s IT and School Education Department are planning to introduce AI in the education system. In a recent state-level review meeting, IT Minister Duddilla Sridhar Babu and Education Secretary Yogita Rana discussed AI integration in schools as part of broader educational reforms.
